title: Reading.create_url references an undefined lookup constant
reasoning: Reading.create_url imports normalize_book_name and then assigns from CATENA_ABBREV_FOR_BOOK_NORMALIZE, but the imported constant in this module is CATENA_ABBREV_FOR_BOOK_NORMALIZED. Calling create_url will raise NameError before it can return either a Catena URL or the home-page fallback. The included tests explicitly exercise create_url for both known and unknown books, so this is a direct correctness regression.
recommendation: Change the lookup in Reading.create_url to use CATENA_ABBREV_FOR_BOOK_NORMALIZED and preserve the existing unknown-book fallback behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests appear intended to cover this, but the excerpt shows the implementation still has the misspelled symbol, so the tests would fail if run against this code path.
suggestedRegressionTest: Keep the existing create_url tests and add a standard straight-apostrophe known-book case to ensure the normalized lookup is used for both ordinary and curly-quote names.

history.note: Code already uses CATENA_ABBREV_FOR_BOOK_NORMALIZED on main; PR #392 adds regression coverage for straight-apostrophe book names.
